pairs.evidence: src/components/modules/project-setup/TestHarnessPanel/useTestHarnessPanel.ts:196 A suite run where every scenario's runTest returns null (bridge readback timed out or was aborted) and no snapshot presets are set has an empty runResults; `every` on an empty array is true, so the suite is recorded as 'passed' with zero results — the empty-success lie the standard forbids.

techniques.evidence: src/components/modules/project-setup/TestHarnessPanel/useTestHarnessPanel.ts:168 A scenario whose readback deadline expired (useTestRunner returns null on timeout) is dropped silently, not reported as a harness failure distinct from a test failure.
src/components/modules/project-setup/TestHarnessPanel/useTestHarnessPanel.ts:184 No floor on executed count; zero results evaluates to allPassed=true and the run is green.

src/components/modules/project-setup/TestHarnessPanel/SnapshotsTab.tsx:19 Re-baseline is a per-preset, confirmed, deliberate act, followed by recapture and re-compare rather than assumed; there is no ambient record mode.

src/components/modules/project-setup/TestHarnessPanel/useTestHarnessPanel.ts:187 A failed or empty snapshot capture counts as not passed, so capture failures cannot pass silently. This is a partial guard only and does not cover the scenario path.
src/components/modules/project-setup/TestHarnessPanel/useTestHarnessPanel.ts:164 Scenarios run serially against the single live editor bridge.

pairs.subject: test-harness
pairs.evidence: src/app/api/pipeline-artifacts/drain/route.ts:56 The drain lease is keyed by catalog|entity scope, and drain-lease.ts:50 explicitly lets scoped drains of different entities run concurrently, yet route.ts:10 says the singleton resource is one non-reentrant UE editor. Two entity drains can therefore drive the same editor at once, which breaks the serial law.

techniques.evidence: src/app/api/pipeline-artifacts/drain/route.ts:56 The singleton (editor) is not what the lease guards. The lease guards artifact scope, so the singleton catalog is keyed wrong.
src/app/api/pipeline-artifacts/drain/route.ts:10 The serial-by-law constraint is stated, but it is enforced only per scope, not per editor.
src/types/observation.ts:23 The observer runs inside the launched game and reports raw substrate samples (location, speed, droop), not the tool's own vocabulary.
src/types/observation.ts:42 ability_found makes the answer name whether the decision was reached ('tag missing' vs 'ran with no effect').
src/types/observation.ts:141 Observation runs use a fixed simulated step, so metrics are read in frames rather than wall time.
src/types/observation.ts:192 A missing UE-side event becomes a named diagnosis instead of a silent empty capture.

pairs.evidence: src/app/api/pipeline-artifacts/drain/route.ts:56 The drain route and settle-test both key the lease on catalog|entity scope, while the resource that cannot be shared is the one UE editor. techniques.evidence: src/app/api/pipeline-artifacts/drain/route.ts:56 The lease guards artifact scope, not the singleton editor.
src/app/api/pipeline-artifacts/drain/route.ts:59 The refusal cites editor non-reentrancy but fires only on a scope conflict.

src/app/api/pipeline-artifacts/drain/settle-test/route.ts:12 An unfound test settles to deferred, never to a pass.
